items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I sent and got Elmer Chambers... from up in Jersey... we had seven entertainers and there was five of us in the band... No, I had Elmer Chambers.

ctx.x: Trombone. I sent and got Elmer Chambers and Charley Dixon from up in Jersey. And Elmer Chambers was from Bayonne and Charley Dixon was from Jersey City. And I got them, and then I had my own --
Elmer Chambers played the what, the tuba, or what?
